name: paperlens
description: 論文PDFを1文単位で読むためのローカルファースト対訳リーダー

scripts.build: npm run build -w @paperlens/core && npm run build -w @paperlens/server && npm run build -w @paperlens/mcp && npm run build -w @paperlens/viewer && npm run build -w @paperlens/web && npm run build -w @paperlens/app
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/server packages/mcp --pretty false && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p apps/viewer --noEmit --pretty false && tsc -p apps/reader --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.test: npm run test -w @paperlens/core && npm run test -w @paperlens/server && npm run test -w @paperlens/app
